headline: Nigerian Naira Pressured by Declining Foreign Currency Inflows and Falling Reserves
summary: The Nigerian naira experienced increased selling pressure across FX market segments. The currency weakness followed a drop in incoming foreign currency flows and a draw-down in central bank foreign reserves.
why: The Central Bank of Nigeria manages official foreign exchange reserves and currency policy.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Lower liquidity in official dollar channels depreciates domestic naira exchange rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Declining dollar inflows and falling central bank reserves weakened foreign exchange spot rates for the naira.
